_comment: Orchestra-managed Codex hooks file. orchestrad renders this into dataDir/codex-hooks.json (replacing __ORCHESTRA_BIN__ with the live `orchestra` binary path); CodexAdapter.prepareToLaunch installs it into the pinned $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (only when absent or already Orchestra's — never clobbering a foreign user hooks.json). Codex's SessionStart hook (Claude-parity) reads `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` from stdout; the `orient` event prints the card's column/mode/self-id orientation. Orientation ONLY — Codex telemetry stays the daemon-side rollout tail, so this hook never sends a StatusReport.
